comment: The coverage contract. Floors, not targets: a build fails when a package
drops below its number, and `covcheck ratchet` raises the numbers to
whatever the suite actually reaches. Floors only ever go up automatically;
lowering one is a hand edit whose diff has to carry the argument.
Per package rather than one total, because a single number lets a
well-tested package pay for a neglected one and says nothing about where
to work next. `covcheck uncovered` answers that.
These floors describe the WHOLE suite: unit tests plus the NixOS VM
scenarios, merged. `make cover` alone is unit-only and prints no floors,
because most of what reaches cmd/kura arrives from the scenarios. For a
Excluding something is allowed and requires a reason in the entry.
